title: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 2.5 Solve Equations with Fractions or Decimals: Solve equations with fraction coefficients
summary: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, 2.5 Solve Equations with Fractions or Decimals: Solve equations with fraction coefficients
body: OpenStax Elementary Algebra 2e, section "2.5 Solve Equations with Fractions or Decimals", prints these objectives: "Solve equations with fraction coefficients" "Solve equations with decimal coefficients". The section text says: "Let’s use the general strategy for solving linear equations introduced earlier to solve the equation, 1 8 x + 1 2 = 1 4 ." This card reports that page. The objectives are the book's learning statements, not a separate proof.
